name: Exp_TrendEnvelopes
summary: This EA trades based on the TrendEnvelopes custom indicator, opening buy positions when an upward trend signal is detected and sell positions when a downward trend signal is detected. It uses configurable money management with lot sizing or deposit share, and applies fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels to all trades. The strategy processes signals only on new bars to avoid redundant calculations.
summary_zh: 该EA基于TrendEnvelopes自定义指标进行交易，在检测到上升趋势信号时开多仓，检测到下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理方式（固定手数或存款比例），并对所有交易设置固定的止损和止盈。策略仅在新K线出现时处理信号，避免重复计算。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用TrendEnvelopes指标跟踪趋势方向进行交易。TrendEnvelopes指标基于移动平均线（支持多种MA方法，默认EMA）加上基于ATR的自适应偏差构建上下轨道，当价格突破上轨时产生买入信号，突破下轨时产生卖出信号。入场条件：当UpSignal缓冲区有有效值（非零且非EMPTY_VALUE）时开多仓，当DnSignal缓冲区有有效值时开空仓；同时如果仅处于趋势轨道内（UpTrend或DnTrend有效但无新信号），则只平反向仓位不开新仓。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数大小，正值表示存款占比。资金管理方面，EA调用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理开仓逻辑，包括信号时间戳、偏差控制和止盈止损设置。策略仅在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时重新计算信号，减少不必要的频繁交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to follow trend direction using the TrendEnvelopes indicator for trading decisions. The TrendEnvelopes indicator is built on a moving average (supporting multiple MA methods, defaulting to EMA) with an ATR-based adaptive deviation to construct upper and lower envelopes. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the UpSignal buffer contains a valid value (non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE), and a sell position is opened when the DnSignal buffer contains a valid value. When price is merely within the trend envelope (UpTrend or DnTrend valid without a new signal), only the opposite position is closed without opening a new one. Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points, plus closing on reverse signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent a fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management is handled through the BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, which incorporate signal timestamps, slippage control, and stop loss/take profit settings. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formations or when SignalBar is set to 0, reducing unnecessary frequent trading activity.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金比例，负值为固定手数大小
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot size (negative=fixed lots)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy signal to close sell positions

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell signal to close buy positions

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制避免信号重复计算和频繁交易，减少过度交易风险
提供灵活的资金管理参数MM，支持固定手数和存款比例两种模式
允许通过布尔参数独立控制买卖开仓和平仓权限，灵活性高
使用ATR自适应偏差构建趋势包络线，能根据市场波动自动调整通道宽度
pros_en: Uses new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing and excessive trading, reducing overtrading risk
Provides flexible money management via MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and deposit share modes
Allows independent control of buy/sell open and close permissions via boolean parameters, offering high flexibility
Uses ATR-adaptive deviation to construct trend envelopes, automatically adjusting channel width based on market volatility
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库和TrendEnvelopes自定义指标，缺少内置回退逻辑，若文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损和止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR或市场波动动态调整，在不同波动环境下可能效果差异大
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高点差时段或不适合交易时段仍会开仓
没有显式的持仓检查逻辑，完全依赖外部库函数处理重复开仓问题
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library and TrendEnvelopes custom indicator with no fallback logic; EA cannot run if these files are missing
Stop Loss and Take Profit are fixed point values without dynamic ATR-based adjustment, which may perform inconsistently across different volatility environments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially opening positions during high-spread periods or unfavorable trading hours
No explicit position check logic in the main code, relying entirely on external library functions to prevent duplicate openings
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，替代固定点数，使风险管理更适应市场波动变化
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic Stop Loss/Take Profit calculation instead of fixed points, making risk management more adaptive to market volatility changes
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 依赖外部库和指标文件，若缺失可能导致运行时错误或无法正常交易
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，低波动时止损过大、高波动时止损过小
没有点差过滤机制，在流动性差或点差扩大时可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: Depends on external library and indicator files; missing files may cause runtime errors or inability to trade properly
Fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit does not account for market volatility changes; SL may be too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility
No spread filter mechanism, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during low liquidity or widened spread conditions
